title: Driving profile
lead: When, how far and how efficiently you drive.

stats.medianHint: Half of your trips are shorter.
stats.avgSpeedHint: distance ÷ time behind the wheel, stops included

when.title: When you drive
when.heatmapNote: Each cell is one weekday and one start hour.
when.calendarNote: Each square is a day; darker means more distance.

length.title: Trip lengths
length.note: Most trips are short, but the long ones carry much of the distance.

efficiency.title: Efficiency
efficiency.note: Consumption is energy-weighted: total energy divided by total distance, not an average of percentages. It is an average over whatever you drove in each class, so the classes are not like-for-like comparisons.
efficiency.legend: Bars: energy-weighted consumption. Whiskers: the middle half of trips (25th to 75th percentile).
efficiency.hiddenNote: Classes with fewer than {{count}} trips that report energy are not shown.
efficiency.shortTripsNote: Short trips use more per kilometre: the battery and cabin are conditioned before the distance is covered.
efficiency.monthNote: Pools the same calendar month across all years.

categories.title: Categories
categories.note: Distance by the category set in the Polestar app.
